description: This file implements classes for handling raw input events such as keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen interactions within the Firefox browser context, specifically for a Playwright-related project. It includes methods for keyboard key presses, mouse movements, clicks, wheel scrolling, and touchscreen taps, utilizing a session interface to send events to the browser.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements raw keyboard input handling, translating key events into WebDriver-compatible functions and sending them via an FFSession.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Implements raw mouse input handling, including move, down, up, wheel events, and maintains page reference for context.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Implements touchscreen tap events, sending them via an FFSession.

methods.name: function toModifiersMask(modifiers: Set<types.KeyboardModifier>): number { toModifiersMask
methods.description: Converts a set of keyboard modifiers to a bitmask.

methods.name: function toButtonNumber(button: types.MouseButton): number { toButtonNumber
methods.description: Converts a mouse button string to a numerical representation.

methods.name: function toButtonsMask(buttons: Set<types.MouseButton>): number { toButtonsMask
methods.description: Converts a set of mouse buttons to a bitmask.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Sends a keydown event to the browser session.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Sends a keyup event to the browser session.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Sends text input to the browser.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the mouse to a specified position with optional button state.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Simulates wheel scrolls with a delay to sync with rendering.

methods.name: setPage
methods.description: Associates a Page object with the mouse input device.
